messages:
deploy-bot: DeployBot starting canary on prod-us-west for tag `v2.3.1-rc3` (commit `abcdef12`). Traffic plan: 1% -> 5% -> ramp. Change window: 09:00-11:00 PST. rollout_id=cr-2077659999

alice.ops: on it — watching logs + canary dashboards.

ci-bot: smoke tests kicked off. quick summary: web=ok, api=ok, kv=ok, auth=ok.

ben.prod: FYI I pinned model-serving config to v3.0 for this rollout to avoid known regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary step 1 complete: 1% -> 5% succeeded. Health checks: OK. median latency +2ms.

carla.pm: anyone seeing anomalies on errors?

alex.sre: minor 500 spikes on adapter around t+7m for ~30s, trending down. watching closely.

sre-oncall: alert: 5xx rate climbed 0.03% -> 0.45% during spike. coincides with coldstart on 2 pods. investigating.

ben.prod: recommend pausing promotion. hold at 5% and exclude nodes with the older driver for now.

deploy-bot: Action taken: pausing ramp at 5%. Promotion on hold. rollout cr-2077659999 remains pinned. To rollback run: `/deploy rollback cr-2077659999`

alice.ops: I'll open a temporary routing pin so canary traffic goes only to the new instance pool.

alex.sre: root cause looks like missing env var `MODEL_CACHE_DIR` in the image causing fallback to disk and higher latency/coldstart. patch in progress (branch: fix/canary-cache-dir).

carla.pm: ETA for patch + redeploy?

alex.sre: patch built, new canary image `v2.3.1-rc3-p1` (commit `fedcba98`). starting redeploy to the canary subset, traffic still at 5%.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: canary redeploy started for `v2.3.1-rc3-p1` (cr-2077659999). Traffic remains 5%.

ci-bot: smoke tests on patched canary: all green. no failures.

alex.sre: monitoring 15m window. no further 5xx spikes observed. latency back to baseline.

carla.pm: propose promotion plan: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 40m if stable. approving to promote :thumbsup:

ben.prod: also keeping model-serving pinned to v3.0 in the promoted config.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled. executing traffic step: 5% -> 20%.

deploy-bot: Promotion step complete. rollout now at 20% (cr-2077659999). change window still open.

alice.ops: dashboards look green. no regressions on key endpoints.

deploy-bot: Continuing ramp: next steps to 50% then 100% in staged increments. will auto-rollback if thresholds breached.

alex.sre: monitoring thresholds: if error rate > 0.2% for 5m or latency p95 increases >20% we'll rollback.

deploy-bot: Final ramp executing. 100% traffic being directed to `v2.3.1-rc3-p1` (commit `fedcba98`).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 100% on `v2.3.1-rc3-p1`. tagging release `release/eng-runtime@v2.3.1`. closing rollout cr-2077659999.

carla.pm: Thanks team — release notes: fix for cache dir env var and improved coldstart handling. will add a short blurb in the release notes doc. :tada:
